handoffs.message: Support-only acceptance packet created at support/sidecars/EVO-004/EVO-004-SIDECAR-ACCEPTANCE.md. It confirms EVO-004 is dependency-unblocked, maps freeze/rollback/retrain/redeploy boundaries, and expands the parent acceptance checklist without changing canonical truth. Use it to resume the parent task, then hand EVO-004 to Gemini for formal review.

Review approved. Packet accurately maps all three dependencies as done (EVO-003/EX-002/INC-001), correctly separates locked canonical truth from EVO-004 open items, and provides a concrete 10-item acceptance checklist (A1-A10) and 3 suggested deliverables. Freeze/rollback boundary analysis is correct and does not collapse the distinction. Packet is a support artifact only — no canonical truth modified. Absorbed into EVO-004 parent work as the dependency-unblocked starting frame.
